newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASKETBALL - ARIS FINED, ALEXANDER BANNED AFTER BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL - ARIS FINED, ALEXANDER BANNED AFTER BRAWL.

text.p: Greek basketball team Aris Thessaloniki was fined 45,000 marks and Gary Alexander of Turkey's Besiktas Istanbul was suspended after a game-ending brawl in the Korac Cup, FIBA said on Wednesday.

The Munich-based International Basketball Federation said the December 11 game, suspended after 20 players were ejected for fighting, was declared void and would be replayed from the start on January 7. The match will be played behind closed doors in Athens, rather than in Salonika.
"The game was stopped because there were not enough players left to continue," a FIBA spokesman said. "There was fighting everywhere."
FIBA said it "most deeply regrets that political problems have affected the progress of a basketball game".
Greece and Turkey have long been at odds over numerous political issues, including the divided island of Cyprus, rights in the Aegean Sea and minority rights in both countries.
Alexander, an American, was arrested by Greek police after the game and charged with assault after Aris forward Dinos Angelidis filed a suit.
Television showed Alexander, who received a four-game suspension from FIBA, hitting Angelidis from behind and then grabbing him and throwing him out of the court.
Other players quickly joined in the brawl and the game was abandoned. Aris led 40-31 a minute and a half into the second half when the violence errupted.
